# SUPPLEMENTARY 3 : ATTRIBUTION TO CODING MUTATIONS:
## a : create a plot for attributions
```{r}
coding_attribution<-read.table('../Signatures/Sigprofiler_SBS_Coding_Mutations/Assignment/Assignment_Solution/Activities/Assignment_Solution_Activities.txt',header=T,sep='\t')%>%
  gather(signature, count, -Samples)%>%
  group_by(Samples)%>%
  mutate(prop=count / sum(count))

coding_attribution$signature=factor(coding_attribution$signature,levels=c('SBS1','SBS5','SBS18','SBS88','SBS89'))
coding_attribution$Samples=factor(coding_attribution$Samples,                          levels=c("all_muts_compiled",'all_missense','all_nonsense' ))
```

```{r}
## plot attributions 
png('/Users/hm14/Downloads/coding_attributions.png',width=1200,height=800,res=150)
ggplot(data=coding_attribution,aes(x=Samples,y=prop*100,fill=signature))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity',position='stack')+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks=c('SBS1','SBS5','SBS18','SBS88','SBS89'),
                    labels=c('SBS1','SBS5','SBS18','SBS88','SBS89'),
                    values=c("wheat2","powderblue","darkslateblue","maroon4","darkolivegreen2"))+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("all_muts_compiled",'all_missense','all_nonsense'),
                   labels=c('All Mutations\n[n=589,876]', 'All Missense\nMutations\n[n=6,047]','All Nonsense\nMutations\n[n=341]'))+
  labs(y='Mutational Signautre Attribution [%Proportion]',fill='Signature')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=10,face='bold'),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=12,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=12,face='bold'),
        )
dev.off()
```


# SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURE 5 : ASSIGNMENT FOR EARLY PHYLOGENETIC BRANCHES
```{r}
phylogenetic_branches<-read.table('../Signatures/Sigprofiler_SBS_Earliest_Branches/Assignment_Solution/Activities/Assignment_Solution_Activities.txt',header=T,sep='\t')%>%
  gather(signature, count, -Samples)%>%
  mutate(Samples=case_when(Samples=='all_patient_branches_less_than_50_max_end_100_unique'~'All Donors',
                           Samples=='coli_pos_patient_branches_less_than_50_max_end_100_unique'~'Colibactin Positive Donors',
                           TRUE ~ 'Colibactin Negative Donors'),
         Samples=factor(Samples,levels=c('All Donors','Colibactin Positive Donors','Colibactin Negative Donors')))
```

## plot output :
```{r}
png('/Users/hm14/Downloads/early_branches_attribution.png',width=1000, height=600,res=150)
ggplot(data=phylogenetic_branches, aes(x=Samples, y=count, fill=signature))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c('All Donors','Colibactin Positive Donors','Colibactin Negative Donors'),
                   labels=c('All Donors','Colibactin Positive\nDonors','Colibactin Negative\nDonors'))+
  scale_fill_manual(breaks=c('SBS1','SBS5','SBS18','SBS88','SBS89'),
                    labels=c('SBS1','SBS5','SBS18','SBS88','SBS89'),
                    values=c("wheat2","powderblue","darkslateblue","maroon4","darkolivegreen2"))+
  labs(y='Mutational Signautre Attribution',fill='Signature')+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=10,face='bold'),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=12,face='bold'),
        legend.title=element_text(size=12,face='bold'),
        
        )
dev.off()
```
